row: Toledo OH Chiropractor - FOUNDATION CHIROPRACTIC CLINIC:  At Foundation Chiropractic Clinic we offer chiropractic care for acute pain care, chronic pain treatments, workers compensation / work place injury treatments, spinal decompression for lumbar disc issues, sports injury treatments as well as wellness programs.  Our goal is to provide the residents of Toledo Ohio with the best possible chiropractic and massage therapy services available.
